transfer.importDescription: Bring in a Markdown bundle exported from a book, or a concept note. Entries are matched by their address: a bundle updates the entries it names and adds the rest; a concept note always adds a new research entry.
transfer.bundleFileHelp: A zip exported with Export Markdown, edited or not. Up to 20 MB.
transfer.bundleTooLarge: That file is larger than 20 MB.
transfer.applyBookDetails: Also replace this book's title and details with the bundle's
transfer.noteNameHelp: Optional. Without one, the note's first line names it.
transfer.noteTextHelp: Paste the note's text. It is kept as written, as a research note's notes.
transfer.noteFileHelp: A .txt or .md file; its text replaces the note above.
transfer.noteRequired: Paste a note or choose a file.
transfer.noteFileTooLarge: That file is too long for a concept note.
transfer.problemsTruncated: More problems were found than are listed here.

reasons.BUNDLE_REFUSED: The bundle was refused; nothing was imported.

reasons.MANIFEST_MISSING: manifest.json is missing: this is not an exported bundle.
reasons.MANIFEST_INVALID: manifest.json is not a bundle manifest.
reasons.FORMAT_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED: This bundle's format version is not supported.

reasons.DUPLICATE_RELATION: This relation is stated more than once in the bundle; keep one.

reasons.UNKNOWN_FIELD: This kind of entry has no such field.
reasons.TOO_MANY_ITEMS: This list has too many items.
reasons.ITEM_NOT_A_STRING: A list item is not text.

setup.titleBook: Grill me on the whole book
setup.description: Choose how the interview asks. Your answers are kept as you give them; nothing reaches the bible until you accept it.
setup.depthHelp: How far down the questions go.
setup.detailHelp: How specific a question is and how long an answer it invites.

depthPreview.3: Consequences and pressures too, in up to {rounds} rounds.
depthPreview.4: Consequences and pressures; it may question what you already wrote. Up to {rounds} rounds.

detailPreview.3: Up to {cap} questions a round; answers of a few sentences.
detailPreview.4: Up to {cap} questions a round; answers of about a paragraph.
detailPreview.5: Up to {cap} questions a round; answers of several paragraphs.

setup.personaHelp: Who asks, and in what manner.
setup.personaNoneSummary: Plain questions in the craft pack's own voice.

personaPreview.none: The craft pack words every question, in one call a round.

personaPreview.many: {count} interviewers share each round, each in its own call ({calls} calls a round); the first leads round 1.
